scope.goal: Track framework workflow readiness for productization.

cases.notes: npm and pnpm install, dev server, browser preview, source edit, HMR state preservation, build, dist smoke, and restart pass in the reference harness.
npm and pnpm install, dev server, browser preview, React render, source edit, HMR state preservation, build, dist smoke, and restart pass in the reference harness.
npm and pnpm install, dev server, browser preview, Vue runtime render, source edit, HMR state preservation, build, dist smoke, and restart pass in the reference harness.
npm and pnpm install, dev server, browser preview, Svelte render, source edit, HMR state preservation, build, dist smoke, and restart pass in the reference harness.

cases.productGap: Actual Vite 8.2.0 worker-backed product runtime covers install artifacts, hydrated dependency materialization, actual Vite CLI dev server start, browser preview relay, real Vite import-analysis transform, React bare package import rewrite, TypeScript/TSX transform fallback, real Vite HMR connected/update payloads, actual Vite build dist artifact generation, and worker bridge reload recovery.

cases.supportContract: The fixture tied to the pinned Vite template-vue upstream passes npm/pnpm install, worker-backed dev/preview, edit-HMR with state preservation, build/dist smoke, and reload recovery within the W6 performance budget.

The fixture tied to the pinned Vite template-svelte upstream passes npm/pnpm install, plugin-backed worker dev/preview, edit-HMR with state preservation, build/dist smoke, and reload recovery within the W6 performance budget.

Pinned Next 15.5.26 real CLI dev/HMR/build/start/restart, App/Pages Router, config/plugin, WASM SWC, RSC/Server Actions, Middleware/Edge, ISR, Image Optimization, binary HTTP responses, lifecycle teardown, and heap budget pass under strict CSP.

gate.reason: Vite React, Vue, and Svelte have worker-backed product support evidence. Pinned Webpack and Rspack workflows have separate strict-CSP Chrome product evidence.
requiredToPass: Keep Vite React product-supported evidence green
Keep Vue and Svelte exact-revision worker-backed support gates green
Keep Webpack and Rspack strict-CSP browser-worker support gates green
Keep Next.js grade explicit without overstating support
